title: AID Protocol v2 — AuditReport
description: Artifact emitted by C3 (auditor) summarising all findings from the pipeline, separated into blocking and non-blocking categories.

allOf.$comment: extends aid-protocol-v2.schema.json envelope (reference only — not a resolved $ref)

findings.$comment: enforced by aid-protocol-validate.sh step 10 — envelope top-level (protocol-v2 convention, D9); audit_report.findings was removed (L2 fix) — this is what aid-protocol-validate.sh:263 actually validates

action_owner.$comment: required when severity is critical or high — enforced by aid-protocol-validate.sh step 10

audit_report.$comment: enforced — provider/model/process_id/input_manifest_hash are required (H1 fix): schema is the only runtime pojistka for the D7 audit_trigger echo, since value-correctness cannot be tested without an actual LLM dispatch

blocking_findings.$comment: true iff envelope top-level findings[] contains a critical|high severity item — mechanical derivation from severity, never LLM-scored

independence_level.$comment: resolved by aid-audit-independence.sh; status=unverifiable when required_independence_level is unreachable or auth fails

input_manifest_hash.$comment: must equal the producing audit-input-manifest.json's .audit_input_manifest.input_hash (provenance chaining)
